title: Evaluation of an OR node
statement: For every natural number $n$, every list $cs$ of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables, and every assignment $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \bbf_2$, the value of the OR node with children $cs$ is equal to the Boolean disjunction of the values of the circuits in $cs$ under $x$.
hypotheses_covered: List $cs$ of circuit trees on $n$ variables
